'''Pokémon the Movie 2000 - The Power of One''' is the English score to the second Pokémon movie, ''[[M02|The Power of One]]''.

It was released on its own in Germany and Brazil. In {{pmin|Australia}}, it was available in a 2-disc bundle pack with [[Pokémon 3: The Ultimate Soundtrack]].

It was released on the [[iTunes Store]] in 2004 by {{wp|Koch Records}}, but it was removed from the store in most countries following iTunes' move to {{wp|iTunes Music Store#Movement against DRM|DRM-free music downloads}}.

==Trivia==
* The version of {{so|Pokémon World}} featured on this album is by [[Russell Velázquez]], not the version from the movie.
* The ninth track, ''The Guardian's Song'' is identical to ''The Legend Comes to Life'' on the [[Pokémon the Movie 2000 (soundtrack)|Atlantic movie soundtrack]].
